description_expanded: SummaryStay in this Miramar Beach home that sleeps 15 with 4 bathrooms and parking for 4 vehicles, located in the gated community of Frangista Beach with deeded beach access and a community pool, just a 5-minute walk or quick ride in the included 6-seat golf cart to the beach. The home offers two king suites, another king bedroom, and a bunk room that sleeps 9 with its own bath, plus a game room and open living spaces, minutes from dining and shopping on Scenic Hwy 98.SpaceLocation perks: — Frangista Beach (0.5 miles) — Silver Sands Premium Outlets (2 miles) — Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort (3 miles) — Destin Commons (4 miles) Interior — Kitchen (Keurig coffee machine, microwave, toaster oven, Crockpot, blender, kettle, cooking utensils, tableware) — 5 Smart TVs (75” in living room) — Game room (air hockey and retro arcade games) — Dedicated workspace (desk and chair) — In-unit washer and dryer — Free WiFi — Central heat and central A/C — 2,356 sq. ft. Exterior — Gas grill — Private patio — Backyard — 6-seat golf cart — Beach supplies — Shared pool — On-site parking for 4 cars (1 in garage, 3 in driveway) — Private gated community with security guard — Walkable, Deeded Beach Access Main floor: Kitchen, dining area, living room, 1 bedroom (king bed), 1 full bathroom Upper floor: 3 bedrooms — two king suites and one bunk room (Triple twin and triple full) — each with a private en-suite bathroom. NeighborhoodMiramar Beach is a quintessential coastal destination known for its iconic white sand and emerald green waters. The neighborhood offers a relaxed yet vibrant atmosphere, perfect for those looking to balance beach days with local exploration. During the summer, the area is a hub for water sports, while the shoulder seasons offer peaceful sunsets and pristine golf courses. You are just minutes away from some of the best shopping and dining on the Panhandle. Visit the Silver Sands Premium Outlets for designer finds or head to the nearby Destin Commons for an open-air shopping and entertainment experience. Local seafood spots and beachside bars are scattered throughout the area, ensuring you are never far from a fresh catch and a coastal breeze. TransitWhile the beach is nearby, a car is recommended to fully explore the surrounding Destin and Miramar Beach attractions. For local trips to the shore, guests can utilize the provided 6-passenger golf cart. Public transit is limited in this area, but ride-share services like Uber and Lyft are readily available. Located in Frangista Beach with private deeded beach access just a short walk or quick golf cart ride away.AccessGuests will have access to the entire home, including the private backyard and patio. All amenities, including the gas grill, in-unit laundry, and the 6-passenger golf cart, are for private guest use. Parking is available for up to 4 vehicles between the garage and the driveway. On-site parking for 4 cars, driveway NotesPlease be sure to check the beach flags before entering the ocean All Wristbands to the pool must be returned to avoid charge Shared pool could be down due to unexpected maintenance outside of our controlHouse Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 18. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 19. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. Read Less
